title: Baba Vanga predicts his Kalmykia presidency

tellings.quote: And then all of a sudden, she tells me, "Ah, you'll go back home. You'll be the leader. You'll be president there."

plain: A man who became president of Kalmykia, a republic within Russia, says that in the early 1990s he visited a Bulgarian fortune-teller known as Baba Vanga. He says she suddenly told him he would go back home and become its leader and president, and he mentions a telegram from Bulgaria tied to the visit, telling it as a prediction that came true.
